THE CHALLENGE

What needed to change.

Increase online sales through the Beeline B2B portal. The product catalog needed to become a clearer path to choosing and purchasing a service.

THE APPROACH

From problem to product.

Restructured the catalog as a product store, simplified navigation and decision-making, clarified pricing, and strengthened cross-sell and upsell flows.

A clearer storefront

Simplified navigation so customers could move through the business service offering.

Better purchase decisions

Introduced a clearer pricing structure and improved the paths to related products and upgrades.
